threats.name: Cross-Chain MEV and Front-Running
threats.description: Attackers exploit speculative transactions for sandwich attacks
threats.vulnerability: RBF interpolation creates predictable speculative tx paths
threats.exploitWindow: Time between speculative and confirmable transaction
mitigations: Encrypted mempools with threshold encryption
Private validator pools for high-value transactions
Randomized Bee algorithm routing with cryptographic randomness
Batch auctions with randomized ordering

threats.name: Bridge Timing Attacks - HTLC Expiration
threats.description: Network delays cause HTLC time-locks to expire unsafely
threats.vulnerability: Different block times across blockchains create temporal windows
mitigations: Conservative timeout calculation: timeout = max_latency * 1.5 + buffer
Adaptive HTLC timeout adjustment based on observed P99 latency
Block-height based timeouts instead of timestamps
Relay chain attestation of message delivery timing

threats.name: Validator Reputation Manipulation
threats.description: Bee algorithm gaming through selective transaction processing
threats.vulnerability: Node score depends on success_rate which can be gamed
attackScenario: Build high success_rate in Bee algorithm
Once selected frequently, start rejecting difficult transactions
Route malicious transactions via this node
mitigations: Score based on transaction difficulty, not just success rate
Slashing mechanism for selective behavior detection
Independent validation for critical transactions
Random validator reassignment

threats.name: Confidence Score Sybil Attacks
threats.description: Sybil attacks to artificially inflate confidence scores
threats.vulnerability: Each confidence component can be individually manipulated

components.senderReputation: Can be gamed with many low-value transactions
components.transactionPattern: Can be mirrored from legitimate patterns

mitigations: Minimum age requirement for transaction history
Weighted history (recent transactions weighted less)
ML-based anomaly detection for suspicious patterns
Cross-chain reputation verification

threats.name: Component Composition Vulnerabilities
threats.description: Interactions between RBF, Bee, ZKP, and Confidence create emergent weaknesses

interactions.RBF → Bee: Inaccurate predictions cause poor node selection
interactions.Bee → Confidence: Malicious node can poison confidence scores
interactions.ZKP → Convergence: ZKP circuit might not enforce all correctness properties
interactions.Confidence → Timeout: Confidence manipulation leads to unsafe timeouts

emergentAttacks.name: Reputation Amplification Chain
emergentAttacks.chain: Bee selection → Reputation build → Confidence manipulation → Timeout attack

emergentAttacks.name: RBF-Confidence Desynchronization
emergentAttacks.chain: Speculative prediction → Confidence based on speculation → Confirmable deviation → Timeout mismatch

mitigations: Formal verification of component composition
Component isolation with minimal information flow
Continuous adversarial testing of boundaries
Independent verification layers

threats.name: Asynchronous Network Desynchronization
threats.description: Unbounded message delays break synchrony assumptions
mitigations: Adaptive convergence threshold based on network conditions
Gossip protocol with exponential backoff
Probabilistic timeouts with failure recovery
Network partition detection and recovery
